Metadata: machine_type, cad_system, material, operation_type, source (shop/pdf/video), confidence_score, operator_id. Auto-rebuilds when LearningEventBus emits 'new_tip'. Sub-200ms top-k retrieval at scale 50K tips.

U-CADC-TK03.title: TribalKnowledgeValidatorEngine — Physics validation of tips before injection
U-CADC-TK03.description: Tribal tips can be wrong (operator superstition, outdated machine advice, contradicts Kienzle/Taylor). Every tip must pass physics validation before being injected into AI context. Validates against PRISM's physics engines: cutting forces (Kienzle), tool life (Taylor), thermal bounds, safety constraints (S(x) gate), material compatibility. Rejected tips are NOT injected but kept for review. Human-in-the-loop override via /shop-knowledge admin.
exit_conditions: Known-wrong tips (curated test set) correctly rejected
Admin review UI shows rejected-tip queue

U-CADC-TK04.title: TribalKnowledgeActivationHookEngine — Hook wiring at every AI entry point
U-CADC-TK04.description: Active wiring of tribal injection at EVERY AI surface: prism_ai reasoning, prism_cad generation, prism_cam strategy, prism_turning/5axis/mill planning, IntentRouterEngine classification, CADUnifiedControlAIEngine dispatch, BlueprintToCADGenerationEngine, NeuralCADGenerationEngine, print-to-CAD capstone pipeline. Implemented as pre-invocation hooks registered via the existing hook registry. Passes explicit opt-out for benchmark/A-B test scenarios.
exit_conditions: All 10+ AI entry points have tribal hooks registered
Hook coverage audit shows zero gaps
Integration test: CAD generation improves ≥5% Ω with tribal hook enabled vs disabled

U-CADC-TK05.title: TribalKnowledgeConflictResolverEngine — Resolve contradicting tips
U-CADC-TK05.description: When two tribal tips conflict (e.g., 'use coolant for M2' vs 'never use coolant for M2 — causes shock'), decide which to apply. Resolution strategy: (1) higher-confidence tip wins; (2) more-recent tip wins; (3) machine-specific beats general; (4) operator with higher success-rate track-record wins; (5) if still tied, inject both with conflict annotation and let AI reason over them. Logs all resolutions to LearningEventBus as 'conflict_resolved' event.
exit_conditions: Resolution rationale logged for every conflict

U-CADC-SA01.title: AICapabilityRegistryEngine — Live inventory of what the AI can do
U-CADC-SA01.description: The AI must know what it knows. Maintains a real-time registry of: every engine (what it does, inputs, outputs, confidence), every algorithm, every formula, every tribal tip category, every trained model + its Ω score, every CAD feature the AI has successfully generated (and failure rate), every plugin currently connected, every learned transfer mapping. Updates on LearningEventBus events. Queryable via prism_agent capabilities / self_awareness.
exit_conditions: Registry covers 100% of engines/algos/formulas (cross-checked vs PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md)
prism_agent self_awareness returns complete accurate inventory

U-CADC-SA02.title: LearningProgressBroadcastEngine — Broadcast learning milestones
U-CADC-SA02.description: When the AI reaches a learning milestone (new CAD feature mastered, Ω gate passed for a CAD app, 1000th successful generation, Weibull MTBF improvement, new material-tool transfer discovered), broadcast to: (1) all concurrent Claude/Codex sessions via shared handoff, (2) prism_realtime WebSocket subscribers for UI updates, (3) slack/email via configurable webhook, (4) LearningEventBus as 'milestone_reached' event. Prevents 'the AI learned something and nobody told anyone'.
exit_conditions: Every milestone broadcast within 1s of detection
6 concurrent sessions all see the broadcast

U-CADC-SA03.title: AIAwarenessDashboardEngine — Self-awareness dashboard for UI
U-CADC-SA03.description: Web UI surface (mcp-server/web/) that shows the AI's current self-awareness state: what models are loaded + their Ω, which CAD apps are connected + their bridge health, tribal tip count + conflict queue depth, learning-event rate (events/sec), last 10 capabilities added, per-CAD generation success rates (last 1h/1d/7d), current pending tasks across 6 chats. Live-updates via WebSocket.
exit_conditions: Dashboard page renders with all 8 widgets
Shows cross-session work from all 6 chats

U-CADC-SA04.title: CrossSessionLearningSyncEngine — Sync learning across 6 concurrent chats
U-CADC-SA04.description: Six concurrent Claude sessions can each be learning different things. This engine synchronizes their learning across sessions using the existing per-agent handoff + cross-session-asset-registry infrastructure. When Session A trains a new model, Sessions B-F are notified via LearningEventBus shared-state polling (5s interval). New tribal tips, new capability registrations, new transfer mappings all propagate across sessions. Prevents duplicate work (Session A and Session B both building the same engine).
exit_conditions: 6-session test: learning in session 1 visible to sessions 2-6 within 10s
Duplicate-work detection fires when two sessions attempt same engine build
No silent divergence after 1h multi-session run

U-CADC-AI01.title: CADUnifiedControlAIEngine — Single master brain for all CAD
U-CADC-AI01.description: Single master AI brain. One entry point (cad_ai_control dispatcher action) that accepts high-level intent and routes to the right CAD app + live bridge + post-processing. Composes: CADIntentDecomposerEngine (AI02), CADExecutionOrchestratorEngine (AI03), CADAIStateMachineEngine (AI04), CADMetaReasoningEngine (U-CADC48), CrossCADMLMetaLearnerEngine (MLC07). Replaces piecemeal per-CAD orchestration with a unified AI surface.
exit_conditions: Single dispatcher action invokes any CAD via NL/structured intent
Falls back across CADs via MLC07 when primary fails

U-CADC-AI02.title: CADIntentDecomposerEngine — NL → {cad, operation, params}
U-CADC-AI02.description: Parses NL intent ('draw a flange with 6 M8 bolt holes on a 100mm BCD') into structured {cad_system, operation_type, parameters, constraints, preferred_bridge}. Uses existing IntentRouterEngine as backbone, adds CAD-specific vocabulary. Consults MLC07 for best-CAD recommendation.

U-CADC-AI03.title: CADExecutionOrchestratorEngine — Route to live bridge + monitor
U-CADC-AI03.description: Takes structured intent from AI02, picks live bridge (Fusion360Live / hyperCADSLive / MastercamLive / SolidWorksLive / InventorLive / FreeCADLive), dispatches ops, monitors execution, captures outcomes for ML feedback. Handles rollback on failure. Integrates with HumanInLoopCorrectionEngine (MLF04).
entry_conditions: All 6 live bridges complete (Fusion exists, HCS01, LDB01-04)
exit_conditions: Routes to correct bridge per intent

U-CADC-AI04.title: CADAIStateMachineEngine — Observable FSM for multi-step CAD flows
U-CADC-AI04.description: Finite state machine: {IDLE, DECOMPOSING, PLANNING, EXECUTING, VALIDATING, LEARNING, FAILED, COMPLETE}. Every transition is observable + logged. Supports pause/resume/inspect. Required for long-running multi-step flows (e.g., blisk generation: sketch → extrude-hub → pattern-blades → fillet-junctions → export).

U-CADC-NN01.title: CADTransformerEngine — Autoregressive CAD op-sequence predictor
U-CADC-NN01.description: Decoder-only transformer predicting next CAD op given prior ops. Tokenization via existing CADTokenRepresentationEngine. Trained on CADTrainingCorpus (9,794 files tokenized). Output: next op + parameter distribution. Enables beam search for op sequences. ~50M params target. Runs on local GPU or Ollama.

U-CADC-NN02.title: CADGraphNeuralNetworkEngine — GNN for assembly + feature topology
U-CADC-NN02.description: Graph neural network (GAT or GraphSAGE) on CAD topology graphs. Nodes: features/bodies. Edges: mate constraints / parent-child / coincidence. Use cases: (a) predict next mate in assembly, (b) classify assembly intent, (c) detect topological anomalies. Extends KnowledgeGraphNeuralBridgeEngine (exists).

U-CADC-NN03.title: CADDiffusionGenerationEngine — Diffusion for parametric sketch synthesis
U-CADC-NN03.description: Diffusion model for sketch generation. Input: part-of image / partial sketch + parameter priors. Output: complete parametric sketch (constraint graph + dimensions). Denoising over parameter space, not pixel space (CadSketch-diffusion approach). Complements U-CADC-NN01 transformer (transformer = discrete op sequence, diffusion = continuous parameters).

U-CADC-NN04.title: PrintEncoderDecoderEngine — Print image → feature sequence (seq2seq)
U-CADC-NN04.description: Encoder-decoder transformer. Encoder: vision transformer (ViT) on print image. Decoder: autoregressive feature-sequence generator (feeds CADTransformerEngine). Fine-tuned on 172 JM Die prints + 1600 UIUC airfoils. Output: feature sequence + GD&T frames + tolerances. Powers PHASE-21 print-to-CAD capstone.

U-CADC-NN05.title: CADReinforcementLearnerEngine — PPO/SAC for trial-error loop
U-CADC-NN05.description: RL agent (PPO for discrete op choice, SAC for continuous params). State: partial CAD model + target spec. Action: next CAD op + params. Reward: geometry-match score + speed + TribalKnowledgeAsRewardSignal (LRN04). Environment: live bridge + geometry comparator. Replaces heuristic retry in U-CADC29.
exit_conditions: Beats heuristic baseline by ≥15% success rate
Reward shaping from tribal tips works

U-CADC-NN06.title: CADFoundationModelEngine — Pre-trained model + fine-tuning API
U-CADC-NN06.description: Composite foundation model: transformer (NN01) + GNN (NN02) + encoder (NN04's ViT encoder) fused via cross-attention. Pre-trained on 9,794 CAD files + 1,600 airfoils + 172 prints. Exposes fine-tuning API for per-customer / per-machine-type specialization. LoRA adapters for cheap fine-tunes. Core ML asset for the CAD AI system.
exit_conditions: Per-customer specialization beats base model by ≥10%

U-CADC-FS01.title: CADOpsFilingSystemEngine — Namespaced op-artifact bundles
U-CADC-FS01.description: Purpose-built filing system for CAD operations. Every AI-initiated CAD op gets a bundle at /data/cad-ops/{op_id}/{version}/ containing: input.json (intent + params), generated.{step,sldprt,f3d,hmc,mcam,FCStd,ipt} (native output), log.jsonl (attempt log compliant with MLF01 schema), comparison.json (vs target if any), screenshot.png, metadata.json (cad_system, bridge_used, duration, success). Content-addressable (hashed) for dedup. Append-only semantics.

U-CADC-FS02.title: CADRevisionManagerEngine — Revision graph + ECN linking
U-CADC-FS02.description: Revision management layer over FS01. Tracks: (a) predecessor bundle (this op derived from which prior op), (b) ECN (engineering change notice) links, (c) branch/merge operations for what-if analysis, (d) 'golden' revision markers (approved by operator). Graph-queryable: 'show all descendants of op_xyz' / 'find golden revision for part P-123'.

U-CADC-FS03.title: CADPartFamilyClusteringEngine — Auto-cluster into part families
U-CADC-FS03.description: Auto-cluster generated CAD files into part families via CADFeatureEmbeddingEngine (exists) + hierarchical clustering (Ward linkage). Results: implicit part families emerge without manual labels. Each family gets a representative template (ties to U-CADC41 auto-template). Speeds future generation via family-specific templates.
exit_conditions: ≥80% cluster purity vs known part families

U-CADC-FS04.title: CADTagFilingEngine — Tag-based indexing + query
U-CADC-FS04.description: Multi-dimensional tag filing: (customer, machine_type, material, feature_type, operation_type, cad_system, complexity_tier, success_flag). Supports boolean queries: 'customer=ALCOA AND machine=lathe AND feature_type=thread'. Backing store: inverted index over FS01 bundles. Web UI for browsing.

U-CADC-FS05.title: CADArtifactAuditTrailEngine — Immutable audit log for every AI-touched CAD file
U-CADC-FS05.description: Immutable append-only audit trail for every CAD file the AI touches. Log entry: {timestamp, actor (AI agent / operator), operation, file_path, hash_before, hash_after, reason}. Hash-chained (each entry references prior hash) for tamper detection. Required for AS9100/IATF audit compliance when shop goes live.
exit_conditions: Audit log writes for every CAD file op

U-CADC-CRD01.title: MultiCADSessionManagerEngine — Concurrent CAD apps for part subdivision
U-CADC-CRD01.description: Runs multiple CAD apps concurrently and delegates subparts to the best CAD for each. Example: complex assembly → Fusion for subassembly A, SolidWorks for subassembly B (sheet metal strength), hyperCAD-S for toolpath. Coordinates session lifecycle, file handoffs (via STEP AP242), concurrent-edit locking. Extends CADCognitiveAgentSwarmEngine (U-CADC50) with process-level parallelism.

U-CADC-CRD02.title: CADIntentFusionEngine — Merge intent from NL + print + prior part + operator demo
U-CADC-CRD02.description: Fuses multi-modal intent sources. User provides: NL description + print PDF + 'like this prior part' + live-demo from operator. Engine fuses into single canonical intent. Uses Bayesian evidence combination + attention weights from user emphasis. Outperforms single-source intent by 25% on ambiguous jobs.
exit_conditions: Beats best single-source by 25% on test set

U-CADC-CRD03.title: CADAIObservabilityEngine — Live dashboard of all CAD AI agents
U-CADC-CRD03.description: Real-time dashboard: per-CAD queue depth, success rate, latency histograms, model version in use, foundation-model adapter active, recent failures, current state per AI02/AI03/AI04 instance. WebSocket-driven web page. Integrates with Prometheus + Grafana via prism_monitoring.

U-CADC-LDB01.title: MastercamLiveBridgeEngine — Interactive control of running Mastercam
U-CADC-LDB01.description: Live drawing bridge for Mastercam mirroring Fusion360LiveBridgeEngine's 14-action surface. Uses Mastercam.App/Database/IO SDK via NET-Hook. Actions: mc_live_sketch, mc_live_surface, mc_live_solid, mc_live_fillet, mc_live_chamfer, mc_live_pattern, mc_live_boolean, mc_live_wireframe, mc_live_export, mc_live_geometry, mc_live_undo, mc_live_new_doc, mc_live_chook, mc_live_execute_raw. Extends existing MastercamStrategyEngine.

U-CADC-LDB02.title: SolidWorksLiveBridgeEngine — Interactive control of running SolidWorks
U-CADC-LDB02.description: Live drawing bridge for SolidWorks via COM. sw_live_sketch, sw_live_feature, sw_live_pm (PropertyManager control), sw_live_fillet, sw_live_chamfer, sw_live_pattern, sw_live_assembly_mate, sw_live_drawing_view, sw_live_export, sw_live_geometry, sw_live_undo, sw_live_rebuild, sw_live_save, sw_live_execute_raw. Drives a running SW instance (not headless).

U-CADC-LDB03.title: InventorLiveBridgeEngine — Interactive control of running Inventor + iLogic
U-CADC-LDB03.description: Live drawing bridge for Inventor via COM + iLogic rule injection. inv_live_sketch, inv_live_feature, inv_live_ilogic_run (inject and execute iLogic snippet), inv_live_fillet, inv_live_sheetmetal, inv_live_pattern, inv_live_mate, inv_live_drawing, inv_live_export, inv_live_geometry, inv_live_undo, inv_live_rebuild, inv_live_save, inv_live_execute_raw.

U-CADC-LDB04.title: FreeCADLiveBridgeEngine — Python console control of running FreeCAD
U-CADC-LDB04.description: Live drawing bridge for FreeCAD via embedded Python console. fc_live_sketch, fc_live_partdesign, fc_live_part, fc_live_fillet, fc_live_chamfer, fc_live_pattern, fc_live_boolean, fc_live_draft, fc_live_techdraw, fc_live_export, fc_live_geometry, fc_live_undo, fc_live_new_doc, fc_live_execute_raw. Streams Python commands to running FreeCAD.

U-CADC-PLG01.title: Fusion 360 Add-In Milestone Wiring
U-CADC-PLG01.description: Wire the existing mcp-server/scripts/fusion360-prism-addin/ (40+ HTTP endpoints, Python + adsk.core/adsk.fusion) into the CAD-COMPLETE-MS0 plan. Audit coverage vs PHASE-18 plugin standard. Expose PRISM panels (speed/feed, materials, tools, quotes, DFM) consistent with SolidWorks/Inventor/FreeCAD/Mastercam plugins. Register with U-CADC106 Integration Hub.

U-CADC-PLG02.title: hyperMILL / hyperCAD-S Plugin — AC + C++ COM
U-CADC-PLG02.description: Native plugin for hyperMILL/hyperCAD-S. Uses existing HyperMillACConnectionManager + HyperMillACScriptExecutor. Exposes PRISM panels in hyperCAD-S (speed/feed, materials, tools, JM Die customer database, cross-CAD template picker). Integrates with omFeatureCatalog_Blade/Impeller. Register with U-CADC106 Integration Hub.

U-CADC-PLG03.title: Siemens NX Add-In — NX Open API
U-CADC-PLG03.description: Native NX add-in via NX Open (Python journal or C++). Ribbon integration for PRISM panels. Journal-based command playback. 200+ NX Open API function coverage. Register with U-CADC106 Hub. Mirrors SolidWorks add-in architecture.

U-CADC-MLF01.title: CADAttemptLogSchemaEngine — Unified ML training data schema
U-CADC-MLF01.description: Canonical Zod+JSON schema for all 6 per-CAD ML loops. Fields: attempt_id, timestamp, cad_system, operation_type, input_parameters, expected_geometry_signature, actual_geometry_signature, success_bool, error_code, retry_count, time_to_success_ms, tribal_tip_applied, operator_correction. All per-CAD logs MUST emit rows matching this schema so PHASE-27 can train cross-CAD models.
exit_conditions: All 6 per-CAD engines emit compliant rows

U-CADC-MLF02.title: FeatureSuccessClassifierEngine — Model architecture for per-feature success prediction
U-CADC-MLF02.description: Formal model: LightGBM/XGBoost classifier predicting P(success | cad_system, operation_type, parameters, material). Trained on U-CADC-MLF01 attempt logs. Auto-calibrated via isotonic regression. Uncertainty via ensemble. Consumed by CADGenerationConfidenceEngine (U-CADC32) as evidence source.

U-CADC-MLF03.title: CADMLTrainingPipelineEngine — Scheduled retrain + versioning
U-CADC-MLF03.description: Training pipeline: ingest new attempt logs → rebuild features → train classifier → evaluate on holdout → promote to production if improves over incumbent. Cron-scheduled nightly + on-demand. Each trained model gets a version ID and hash. Integrates with U-CADC-MLF06 registry.

U-CADC-MLF04.title: HumanInLoopCorrectionEngine — Operator feedback → training data
U-CADC-MLF04.description: When AI generation fails, operator can: (a) correct parameters, (b) demonstrate via live bridge. Correction is captured as an attempt log row with human_corrected=true flag. Weighted 5× in retraining. Closes the loop for edge cases ML alone can't reach.

U-CADC-MLF05.title: TransferLearningProtocolEngine — Formal cross-CAD transfer rules
U-CADC-MLF05.description: Formalizes what CROSS-CAD transfers and what doesn't. Protocol: (a) parameter-level transfer (fillet radius same in mm across CAD), (b) strategy-level transfer (feature ordering heuristics), (c) geometry-invariant checks (can SW PropertyManager ranges import to Inventor iLogic?). Governs U-CADC-MLC07 CrossCAD meta-learner.

U-CADC-MLF06.title: CADMLModelRegistryEngine — Versioning, A/B testing, rollback
U-CADC-MLF06.description: Central registry for all CAD ML models. Versioned storage, A/B traffic splitting, shadow mode (run new model alongside incumbent, compare), rollback, drift detection. Mandatory for any model served in production.

U-CADC-CVG01.title: RegenFailureAutoRetryEngine — Progressive strategy escalation
U-CADC-CVG01.description: For every file that fails U-CADC-MSR05 (gauntlet), retry with progressively expensive strategies: (1) direct CAD system switch (try next best per MLC07), (2) progressive complexity (U-CADC33), (3) multi-agent swarm (U-CADC-CADC50), (4) template search + adapt. Escalates until success or exhausts all strategies.

U-CADC-CVG02.title: RegenHumanFallbackEngine — Last-resort operator assist + learn
U-CADC-CVG02.description: For the final ~5% that even auto-retry can't crack, queue to operator. Operator completes via live bridge; the trajectory is captured as a U-CADC-MLF04 correction; all future similar files attempt the corrected approach first. Guarantees 100% long-term coverage.

U-CADC-CVG03.title: RegenCompletionGate — MS0 exit: 100% of 9,794 files
U-CADC-CVG03.description: Final MS0 exit gate. Runs full corpus (9,794 files) through auto-retry + human fallback. Exit criterion: 100% generated within tolerance (volume ≤5%, bbox ≤2%, topology match). If <100%, reports remaining files + strategy. When 100% achieved, MS0 is closable.
U-CADC-CVG03.scrutiny_source: Round 10 R13 user: 'every single cad file in the h drive'

U-CADC-LRN01.title: CADVideoHarvestEngine — /video-learn pipeline for CAD tutorials
U-CADC-LRN01.description: Harvests YouTube/Vimeo CAD tutorials per CAD system using existing /video-learn skill. Target sources: official Autodesk/Dassault/OPEN MIND channels, third-party educators (Lars Christensen, SolidWorks Tutorials, CNC Cookbook). Extracts transcripts via Whisper, keyframes via ffmpeg, then /video-learn structures into tribal tips + workflow sequences.

U-CADC-LRN02.title: CADLearningToMLPipelineEngine — Harvest outputs → structured ML training data
U-CADC-LRN02.description: Translation layer. PHASE-8 PDFs + PHASE-29 videos yield tribal tips (text). But PHASE-24 ML loops need structured attempt-log rows (U-CADC-MLF01 schema). This engine parses tribal tips using LLM extraction into synthetic attempt logs: 'For Inconel 718 on Mastercam Dynamic Motion, use 40% stepover, 0.005 chipload' → row with cad=mastercam, op=dynamic_motion, params={stepover:0.40, chipload:0.005}, success=implied-true. Feeds cold-start training before real attempts accumulate.

U-CADC-LRN03.title: PDFKnowledgeToAttemptLogEngine — Convert manual examples into training attempts
U-CADC-LRN03.description: Specializes on vendor manual examples (Inventor CAM 'Example 2.5D' sections, hyperMILL Blade walkthroughs). Each example becomes a gold-standard attempt log entry with success=true and operator_validated=true. Highest-quality synthetic training data.

U-CADC-LRN04.title: TribalKnowledgeAsRewardSignalEngine — Tips → RL reward shaping
U-CADC-LRN04.description: Validated tribal tips become reward-shaping signals for the trial/error learning loop (U-CADC29). 'Always pilot drill before deep holes' → +reward when pilot-drill precedes deep-hole op. Tips are weighted by validation count and operator confidence. Bridges tribal knowledge into the RL formulation.

U-CADC-MLC07.title: CrossCADMLMetaLearnerEngine — Transfer learning + best-CAD picker
U-CADC-MLC07.description: Aggregates all 6 per-CAD learning loops. Cross-CAD meta-reasoner: 'for a swept-loft blade feature, Fusion360 succeeds 91%, FreeCAD 62%, SolidWorks 88% — choose Fusion360'. Transfer learning: when Mastercam solves a pattern that other CAD systems struggle with, propagates the approach. Feeds CADMetaReasoningEngine (U-CADC48) as its evidence backend.
U-CADC-MLC07.scrutiny_source: Round 9 R12 user follow-up: per-CAD ML feature learning (cross-CAD aggregator)

U-CADC-CSO01.title: CustomerStyleFingerprintEngine — Per-customer drawing fingerprint
U-CADC-CSO01.description: Extract per-customer style fingerprint: tolerance defaults, note-block format, datum conventions, GD&T style, dimension placement, title-block layout. One fingerprint per customer_id. Updates on every new drawing ingest. Vector embedding for similarity queries.
exit_conditions: Fingerprints exist for 20+ JM Die customers with >=95% coverage
Delta between two customers measurable as L2 distance
Fingerprint auto-updates within 1 min of new drawing ingest

U-CADC-CSO02.title: CustomerStyleDeltaAnalyzerEngine — Delta vs shop baseline
U-CADC-CSO02.description: Quantify how a customer style differs from the shop baseline. Output categorical delta (stricter tolerances, different datum scheme, unusual note format) + numeric delta (tolerance tightening %, dim-placement offset). Feeds calibration priority.
exit_conditions: Delta report generated for all customers
Top-3 deltas per customer explain >=80% of variance

U-CADC-CSO03.title: CustomerStyleCalibrationLadderEngine — Per-customer 10/50/200 ladder
U-CADC-CSO03.description: Ladder-based calibration: 10 drawings -> 50 -> 200, each stage gates on Omega improvement for that customer. Fine-tunes per-customer LoRA adapter on top of base model. Uses customer-stratified split (no leakage).
exit_conditions: Omega improvement per customer tracked at each rung
Rung promotion gate requires >=2% Omega lift
Per-customer LoRA adapter saved to model registry

U-CADC-CSO04.title: CustomerStyleDriftAlarmEngine — Drift alarm on standards shift
U-CADC-CSO04.description: Customer standards drift over time. When incoming drawings show fingerprint delta > threshold vs historical, alarm fires. Routes to LearningEventBus + operator review queue.
exit_conditions: PSI drift detection working on synthetic drift
Alarm fires within 5 drawings of >=3-sigma drift

U-CADC-INT01.title: IMAPEmailIntakeEngine — Email drawing parser
U-CADC-INT01.description: Watchdog on IMAP/O365 mailbox; extracts PDF/DXF/STEP attachments, dedups via SHA-256, routes to canonical intake queue with sender metadata.
exit_conditions: Parses 100+ real customer emails with >=99% attachment extraction

U-CADC-INT02.title: MobileScanIntakeEngine — iOS/Android PWA scan
U-CADC-INT02.description: Progressive web app for mobile camera capture: auto-crop, perspective correction, glare removal, multi-page stitching, upload with GPS + operator tag.
exit_conditions: PWA installs on iOS Safari + Android Chrome

U-CADC-INT03.title: ScannerDropFolderEngine — MFD/scanner watchdog
U-CADC-INT03.description: Watches network share (Xerox/Ricoh/Canon MFD output folder). New files trigger OCR preprocess + dedup + intake queue insertion.

U-CADC-INT04.title: FaxIntakeEngine — eFax/RightFax bridge
U-CADC-INT04.description: Bridge to eFax / RightFax / etherFAX APIs. Incoming fax -> PDF -> canonical intake queue. Fax metadata preserved.
exit_conditions: Integrates with at least one fax-to-email provider

U-CADC-INT05.title: CanonicalIntakeQueueEngine — Unified intake queue + dedup
U-CADC-INT05.description: Canonical queue that all 4 intake channels feed. Dedup by perceptual-hash (pHash/dHash for images) + SHA-256. Priority ordering. Status tracking through downstream pipeline.
exit_conditions: Perceptual-hash dedup catches re-scans and rotated duplicates
Integration test: 4 channels feeding 100 drawings yields canonical unique set

U-CADC-LEG01.title: MastercamMCXReaderEngine — .mcx-8 / .mcx parser
U-CADC-LEG01.description: Read JM Die 7,092 .mcx-8 + 1,779 .mcx files via Mastercam NET-Hook API from PHASE-18 plugin. Extract geometry, toolpaths, tools, setups, operations.

U-CADC-LEG02.title: MastercamSemanticExtractorEngine — Semantic map from raw MCX
U-CADC-LEG02.description: Transform raw MCX data into canonical schema: feature list, tool list, setup sheet, machining-strategy tags. Enables cross-system translation.
exit_conditions: Semantic schema matches PRISM internal format
Coverage: dynamic motion, 2D contour, pocket, drill, peel mill, OptiRough, thread mill

U-CADC-LEG03.title: MastercamTargetTranslatorEngine — Semantic -> target-CAD
U-CADC-LEG03.description: Translate extracted semantic to target systems: Fusion 360, hyperMILL, NX. Handles strategy mapping (Mastercam Dynamic Motion <-> hyperMILL iMachining).
exit_conditions: Translates 50+ sample programs to all 3 targets
Mapping table documented for every strategy
Re-execute translated program in target CAD + verify motion

U-CADC-LEG04.title: MigrationRegressionDiffEngine — Original vs migrated verification
U-CADC-LEG04.description: Run BOTH original and migrated programs in simulation; diff toolpaths, cycle time, surface finish prediction, MRR, chatter risk. Pass gate: delta <=2% on all metrics.
exit_conditions: All migrated programs within 2% of original metrics
Failed migrations quarantined with reason code

U-CADC-APR01.title: CADApprovalQueueEngine — Multi-role approval queue
U-CADC-APR01.description: Queue generated CAD files for approval by programmer/lead/QE roles. Role-gated transitions. SLA tracking. Routes rejects back to generation loop.
exit_conditions: Rejection routes back with reason code

U-CADC-APR02.title: CADESignatureAuditEngine — E-sig + audit trail
U-CADC-APR02.description: E-signature on approval (PIN + cert). Hash-chained audit trail linking signature to CAD file version + reviewer identity + timestamp + reason. AS9100/IATF/21-CFR-11 compliant.
